name: Crystal Dragon (Ancient)
savenote: +2 status to all saves vs. primal

defensiveAbilities.name: Cobblegems
defensiveAbilities.description: 10 feet. The dragon constantly sheds crystalline scales onto the ground around it. The area is uneven ground (DC 34).

defensiveAbilities.name: Shielding Stone
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature at least 10 feet away from the dragon targets them with an attack

Requirements The dragon is on the ground and there is at least one unoccupied square between themself and the attacker

Effect The dragon conjures a thin slab of stone in an unoccupied square between themself and the attacker. The dragon gains standard cover against the triggering attack. The stone falls on the first person other than the dragon who enters that square, dealing 8d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage with a Basic DC 34 Reflex Saving Throw save. Otherwise, it crumbles harmlessly after 1 round.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shimmering Armor
defensiveAbilities.description: When the dragon takes a critical hit from any attack that deals physical damage, its hide chips, releasing sharp slivers. All creatures in a 10ft Type:emanation take 13d8 Piercing Damage damage with a Basic DC 34 Reflex Saving Throw save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crystallize
offensiveAbilities.description: The claws of an ancient crystal dragon embed shards that slowly turns the flesh of those they Strike to crystal. The target must succeed at a DC 34 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Slowed 1 (Slowed 2 on a critical failure) for 1 minute. Further failed saves against crystallize increase the slowed condition. Once a creature's actions are reduced to 0 by crystallize, that creature becomes petrified, turned into crystal instead of stone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon recharges their Ornamental Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Lustrous Lunge
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon strikes a pose that makes its hide sparkle in the light. Each creature within 20 feet must succeed at a DC 34 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Dazzled for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ornamental Breath
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon exhales a torrent of shattered rocks and minerals in a 50ft Type:cone dealing 16d6 Piercing Damage damage (DC 37 Reflex Saving Throw save). A creature who fails the save is weighed down by the stones, becoming Clumsy 1 (Clumsy 2 on a critical failure).
